title: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.26463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data assimilation (DA) in partially observed nonlinear systems requires repeated estimation of both hidden states and their uncertainty. Conventional nonlinear filtering can be computationally expensive and often relies on an explicit dynamical model. In this paper, we develop the Neural Conditional Gaussian Model (Neural CGM), a data-driven dynamical model that maps unobserved physical states into a learned latent space, where the dynamics of the latent states follow a conditional Gaussian structure. This structure allows closed-form DA updates in the latent space, while nonlinear encoder-decoder mappings retain the flexibility needed to represent complex dynamics in physical space. A key feature of Neural CGM is its treatment of uncertainty in DA. translated_title: 神经条件高斯模型：面向非线性动力学的高效数据同化与序贯不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 在部分可观测的非线性系统中进行数据同化（DA）需要对隐含状态及其不确定性进行反复估计。传统的非线性滤波方法计算代价高昂，且通常依赖于显式的动力学模型。本文提出了神经条件高斯模型，这是一种数据驱动的动力学模型，它将未被观测到的物理状态映射到一个学习得到的潜在空间中，其中潜在状态的动力学遵循条件高斯结构。这一结构使得潜在空间中的数据同化更新具有闭式解形式，同时非线性编码器-解码器映射保留了在物理空间中表征复杂动力学所需的灵活性。Neural CGM 的一个关键特性在于其对数据同化中不确定性的处理：潜在后验均值和协方差通过一个结合了局部矩传播与学习到的非线性修正的高斯解码器映射回物理变量。由此产生的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出神经条件高斯模型，将未观测的物理状态映射到具有条件高斯结构的潜在空间，从而实现闭式数据同化更新，并通过高斯解码器对物理变量进行高效的不确定性量化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Neural Conditional Gaussian Model, which maps unobserved physical states into a latent space with conditional Gaussian structure, enabling closed-form data assimilation updates and efficient uncertainty quantification for physical variables through a Gaussian decoder.
